definitions.explanation: Actual accomplishments or proven results, often in work or business.
A documented history of past performance and achievements.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{営業|えいぎょう}で{素晴|すば}らしい{実績|じっせき}を{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: He achieved excellent results in sales.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{売|う}り{上|あ}げ{実績|じっせき}は{去年|きょねん}を{上回|うわまわ}った。
examples.english: This year's sales results exceeded last year's.

examples.japanese: {地道|じみち}に{実績|じっせき}を{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねてきた。
examples.english: I've been steadily building up a track record.

examples.japanese: {実績|じっせき}のある{会社|かいしゃ}に{依頼|いらい}したい。
examples.english: I want to hire a company with a proven track record.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}の{実績|じっせき}を{評価|ひょうか}して{採用|さいよう}を{決|き}めた。
examples.english: We decided to hire based on an evaluation of past achievements.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}は{海外|かいがい}{展開|てんかい}の{実績|じっせき}が{豊富|ほうふ}で、{信頼|しんらい}できるパートナーだ。
examples.english: This company has extensive experience in overseas expansion and is a reliable partner.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{実績|じっせき}を{上|あ}げる (to achieve results)
・{実績|じっせき}がある (to have a track record)
・{実績|じっせき}を{積|つ}む (to build up achievements)
・{実績|じっせき}{報告|ほうこく} (performance report)

BUSINESS CONTEXT:
{実績|じっせき} is frequently used in business to refer to:
・Sales results ({営業|えいぎょう}{実績|じっせき})
・Past performance ({過去|かこ}の{実績|じっせき})
・Proven abilities ({実績|じっせき}のある〜)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{成果|せいか} - results, achievements (output)
・{業績|ぎょうせき} - business results, achievements
・{功績|こうせき} - meritorious service, distinguished achievements
